ambiguities.text: This fork will push back the Iceage as far as is reasonable
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'reasonable' is defined by the specific offset value in EIP-2384. The term is intentionally vague to allow flexibility in the exact delay amount.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly state what happens if a node disagrees about fork activation
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard consensus rules apply - nodes that don't upgrade will fork off and follow the pre-fork chain.

implicit_assumptions.description: Node operators will upgrade their software before the fork block is reached
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-upgraded nodes will experience chain split and follow a minority fork with increasing difficulty

implicit_assumptions.description: The difficulty bomb mechanism continues to function as designed in the original protocol
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: The delay may have unexpected effects if the underlying difficulty adjustment algorithm has bugs

implicit_assumptions.description: Block number is accurately tracked and cannot be manipulated by miners
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Miners could potentially trigger or delay fork activation by manipulating block numbers
